# OFFDAYA

> OFFDAYA plans holidays, stays and workations, with Lakshadweep island escapes, classic and offbeat Kashmir journeys, and Kerala resort and homestay enquiries.

## Website

- [About the team](https://offdaya.in/about): Our story and approach to personal travel planning.
- [Holiday packages](https://offdaya.in/packages): Itineraries, inclusions and enquiries. Quotations are provided on request.
- [Lakshadweep Escape](https://offdaya.in/packages/lakshadweep-escape): A 3-night, 4-day Agatti and Kalpitti itinerary.
- [Beyond Kashmir](https://offdaya.in/packages/beyond-kashmir): Offbeat Kashmir routes, villages and trails.
- [Classic Kashmir](https://offdaya.in/packages/classic-kashmir): Familiar Kashmir destinations and sightseeing.
- [Kerala stays](https://offdaya.in/stays): Stay enquiries for Kakkadampoyil, Wayanad, Anakkampoyil, Munnar, Poovaranthode and Thusharagiri.
- [Services](https://offdaya.in/services): Complete planning and local coordination.
- [Contact](https://offdaya.in/contact): Email hello@offdaya.in or WhatsApp +91 79948 49989.
- [Sitemap](https://offdaya.in/sitemap.xml): Published website pages.

## Booking details

The website accepts enquiries. Availability, accommodation, inclusions, activities, permits and quotations are confirmed before booking. Destination imagery includes illustrative AI-generated scenes and traveller-supplied photographs.
